info.name: EduAuth Registry API
info.description:
EduAuth Registry API Collection — Updated 2026-10-03

DEMO CREDENTIALS:
  Admin:      admin@eduauth.com / admin123
  Student:    student@test.com / password123
  University: demo@uiu.ac.bd / password123
  Verifier:   verifier@company.com / password123

HOW TO START:
  1. Open '🚀 Start Here — Login as Each Role'
  2. Run all 4 login requests — tokens save automatically
  3. All other requests use these tokens automatically

COLLECTION VARIABLES (auto-populated or set manually):
  base_url: http://localhost:8080/api
  admin_token, student_token, university_token, verifier_token
  student_id, certificate_id, enrollment_id, application_id,
  extension_request_id, access_request_id, program_id

TEST FLOWS (run in order for a full demo):
  Flow 1: Full Auth Flow
  Flow 2: Certificate Verification
  Flow 3: Issue Certificate
  Flow 4: Verifier Access Request
  Flow 5: Student Application to University
  Flow 6: Admin Management
  Flow 7: Student University Application
  Flow 8: Extension Request
  Flow 9: Certificate Privacy + Verification Alert
  Flow 10: Account Deactivation and Reactivation
  Flow 11: Program Management

TOTAL ENDPOINTS: 165
